description: Perfume and fragrance layering ideas: which notes or perfumes combine well, what the combination smells like, how to spray (order, amount) and when it suits. Works from two notes ('vanilla and citrus'), one note (what it layers with), one perfume (partners from the index) or two perfumes (does this pair work). Editorial pairings are marked 'editors'; others are marked 'suggested' and should be tested on skin. Use for 'how do I layer vanilla', 'can I layer Delina with something', 'does Sauvage layer with Aventus'. Not for choosing a single perfume (use recommend_perfumes).

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

perfumes.description: One or two perfumes. Examples: ["Parfums de Marly Delina"], ["Dior Sauvage","Creed Aventus"]

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).
